page.overview:
Who is Rikiel?

Rikiel is one of DIO's illegitimate children with an unnamed woman. When he fatefully meets with Enrico Pucci, he awakens his Stand, Sky High, and battles Jolyne Cujoh and Ermes Costello.

Rikiel is a young, decently built man with a long face. He has dark hair styled into a bob that tucks into his cow print high collar. He wears a sleeveless and hooded bodysuit patterned after the hide of a stereotypical cow with an opening on his chest. He wears an assortment of arm warmers. As a son of DIO he possesses the Star Birthmark on his left shoulder.

Rikiel is initially a meek youth distraught by the numerous afflictions he suffers from, causing him to have confidence issues. As a teenager he was disturbed by an unknown ailment with strange symptoms: his eyelids would close, it'd become hard to breathe, and he'd start panicking as a result. Rikiel is filled with anxiety and immediately breaks down in front of Pucci during their first meeting. When Pucci unlocks his Stand Sky High, Rikiel becomes more confident, and is seen evolving into an honorable and brave fighter during his fight with Jolyne. Rikiel holds human progress in high esteem and sees , as a symbol of human growth. Rikiel is a man of honor and fights to repay his debt to Pucci, and when Jolyne defeats him, he congratulates her and reveals details about Pucci being Weathers older brother. He inherited his father Dio's determination and hardcore actions as well as a rare trait of acknowledging a worthy opponent.

Sky High allows Rikiel to control creatures known as flying rods which absorb body heat and create localized illnesses.right|thumb|100x
